EDDLESTONE, 14 September 2024 (Meridian Brief) — A border collie took best in show at the Eddlestone Dog Trials on Saturday, the final day of the event, according to people familiar with the matter.

Marguerite Holloway, chief steward of the Eddlestone Canine Association, announced the result following the closing ceremony. In all, 212 dogs across 31 breeds competed over the course of the trials.

The outcome was confirmed in the association's official results bulletin, issued after the ceremony concluded.

People familiar with the matter said the border collie's win capped a closely watched final day. No further details on the winning dog's performance were immediately available.

The Eddlestone Canine Association is expected to release additional information on the trials in the coming days, those people said.

Meridian Brief will update this item as further details emerge.
